description: Latest UK public sector tender notices from Find a Tender (OCDS release packages): notice ID, date, buyer, title, estimated value in GBP, tender deadline and status. Returns the newest page only; no full documents. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_canadabuys_tenders when you need Open Government of Canada tender notices; gov_data_gov_uk when you need UK government open datasets from the data.gov.uk catalogue. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
